tool: Fingertips on the two long sides, holding the wall steady
remove: Find the white four-stud tile where the long back-room wall meets the perpendicular end tile. Hold the wall steady. Pinch the marked tile by its long edges and lift straight up.
exchange: Set the removed tile aside. Take the matching white 1 × 4 grooved spare, smooth face up.
restore: Align the spare over the same four studs. Press straight down evenly at both ends.
check: Run a finger across the two ends of the tile. Check that the top is flush with the neighbouring tiles and the wall has stayed seated.
